original_local_details: Parent-authorized implementation candidate: R2-LOCAL-BERTH-DUTY is a local functional landing watch, not a new core character, recruited companion or tower crew member.
Its issued handoff names the actual GLIMMER instance and Q104 loan/commission, and permits only approach and public landing at the learner package's R2-S01.berth stand.
The handoff is an engine-issued local service record checked at the ship chart by N-DECKWATCH. It is neither the player's claim nor permission to inspect archive identities.

Only exact actual package collision geometry, paired public landing access, legal ship ownership, current registered source berth/ship cabin and the bounded first-region commission are checked. No invented tides, weather, distances, survey measurements or sailing tests are added.
Issuing this limited future arrival handoff does not discover or grant any unvisited R2 material; arrival registration and local work remain separate physical actions.
remaining: Original local duty and production content need human editorial review; this is a scoped implementation candidate, not a formal acceptance or human signature.
Only the first R1/R2 voyage is produced. R3-R6 and final-route producers remain independent required work.
The normal service/test path provides actual command navigation and persistent receipt evidence; native user journey, story audition and language calibration remain pending.
